script: Chosen: Rescued you again. Don’t thank me. Actually, do. #l:0caf
Hazel: Same spot over the dock. To the metre. #l:11db
Chosen: Yanked you out just in time. Professor reflexes. #l:bd0a
Hazel: You landed exactly in the mast’s shadow. Exactly. #l:abb6
Chosen: At this point I should charge for rescues. #l:fefa
Hazel: Something out there keeps sending you back. Folded. Like a returned parcel. #l:af04
Chosen: You lost to a clerk and I still saved you. Generous of me. #l:ba8e
Hazel: There was a stamp on your sleeve. “Returned to sender.” It wasn’t there when you left. #l:0df7
Your first expedition! I’d have done it faster, but I was busy being chosen. #l:b1b0
[happy] You won! I taught you that. I’m not sure when. Possibly in a dream we shared. #l:ed8d
Down that early? Bold. Avant-garde. Next time try the part where you win. #l:3752
You reached the big one and blinked. I respect a dramatic exit. #l:ef10
[surprised] Three in a row. I’ve decided this is a training montage. Montages end well. Usually. #l:f8bc
Home early. Leave them wanting more. That’s what I always say. I’ve never said that. #l:5806
[angry] A clerk? You lost to paperwork? I once lost to a form. We don’t talk about the form. #l:0564
You came back through the same hole. I measured it. It’s getting rounder. #l:5be0
Every time you lose out there, you land in the same spot. Things don’t fall that tidily. #l:2b31
You won and came home by train. Good. The other way home makes my instruments hum. #l:df6c
The clerk who beat you. Did they mention a file? A number? ...No reason. #l:41c7
That many Perks in one run. You sound like someone I work with. Not a compliment. #l:1d8e
Five expeditions. Juniper started a scrapbook. Someone in a lab coat keeps pasting himself into it. #l:6ba3
Back already, dear? Sit. The kettle doesn’t care who won. #l:45be
[happy] Oh, you won! I’ll tell the bees. They pretend not to care. They care. #l:1f91
Two rough trips in a row. Eat something green. It won’t help, but it’s green. #l:8e6a
You were gone a while. The lavender grew back. Mind where you land. #l:d521
“I’m a leader. It says so on my badge. Let’s see yours.” #l:8ee4
“You again! I remember your team. Mostly the fainting.” #l:e094
“Word is you’ve beaten a boss. Word says a lot of things.” #l:a4ee
“You look lost. That is our department.” #l:492a
“Ah. You’re on file. Returned item, handled once.” #l:7ffb
“Your file is getting thick. We’ll need a bigger drawer.” #l:2ca8
“A win, recorded. Wins are reviewed. Reviews take time.” #l:aaec
Every book here is shelved by the colour of its spine. The Bureau would hate it. That’s the point. #l:593f
I’ve unpacked my cardigan and three hundred files. The library is open, if you count me as open. #l:a8d0
[happy] A win! I’ll file it under “Wins”. It’s a thin folder. Let’s fatten it. #l:0318
Lost? I’ll file that under “Lessons”. It’s my thickest folder. I love it. #l:5d9a
The Bureau beat you? They keep a form for that. I used to stamp it. Sorry. #l:9708
The shelves are empty, but they’re very good shelves. Top quality nothing. #l:e205
[happy] Mo Stockley, open for business! Business hasn’t arrived yet. I’ll wait by the door. #l:6726
You won? Then you can afford something. Once I have something. #l:1e91
Lost everything out there? Same thing happened to my stock. We’re practically twins. #l:8516
Bertha keeps sending people here for bread. I don’t sell bread. I barely sell shelves. #l:bba1
Heard a rumour you were about. Turns out it’s true. Pull up a chair. #l:d9c7
The inn’s got a roof, a kettle and me. Two of the three are very loud. #l:f8dd
[happy] A win! By supper the whole island will know. By breakfast it’ll be two bosses. #l:91da
Rough trip? Sit down. I’ll tell everyone you won. Nobody checks. #l:2188
Copperleaf’s filling up. More neighbours, more gossip. This is my golden age. #l:d688
If it rattles, I can fix it. If it doesn’t rattle, I can fix that too. #l:ecb0
Nice Workshop. Somebody left the tools in alphabetical order. I’ll sort that out. #l:e751
You won? Bring back any scrap? Bots, bits, bolts. I’m not fussy. #l:312b
Came back in pieces, eh? Happens to the best machines. Rest up. #l:e9fb
The big one got you? Everything’s got a loose bolt. You just have to find it. #l:38a1
The Billies say hello. Well, one of them did. The rest were eating. #l:7340
I’ve met every Billie in the pasture. Two of them have already filed complaints. #l:46bf
[happy] The Billies heard you won. They did a little dance. It looked like falling over. #l:4ece
Lost out there? The Billies don’t mind. They lose to the fence every day. #l:0903
Five trips out. The pasture’s keeping count. Mostly by chewing the scoreboard. #l:d4cb
I’ve mapped Copperleaf twice. It moved a little the second time. Islands do that. #l:95e0
Skyline Station has the best view of places that don’t exist yet. I’ll draw them before they do. #l:ef4a
You won? Then the map you took is finished. I’ll frame it and start another. #l:70f1
Lost? Not on my maps, you weren’t. You were exploring very quickly backwards. #l:e65f
Down that close to the start? The first rows are the hardest to draw. Try again. #l:904d
Hold still. Thirty-two by... no, don’t breathe. Thank you. #l:7074
A cottage with good light. Perfect for sewing, terrible for napping. I’ll manage. #l:5d62
A win suits you. The jacket doesn’t. We’ll talk. #l:4bde
Torn sleeve, mud on the knees. Leave it with me. Leave the Billie hair too. I collect it. #l:7a57
Hayden came in smelling of hay and wanting a suit. I said yes. I regret nothing. #l:5472
Genes are a menu. Most people order the same thing. Not me. #l:9b7b
The Gene Bank is lovely. The vault hums. I hum back. We get along. #l:e417
You won! I’d love a sample of whatever made that happen. Kidding. Mostly. #l:9199
A loss is just data with feelings. Rest, then bring me more data. #l:e850
